data.title: KSrelief Provides Drinking Water to 340 Families in Yemen's Lahj
data.content:
Lahj, November 20, 2026, SPA -- The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief) supplied safe drinking water on Wednesday to displaced families in Lahj Governorate, Yemen.
    The assistance benefited 340 families as part of an emergency response project to provide drinking water to displaced people in Lahj.
    -- SPA
23:10 Local Time 20:10 GMT
